typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		SiteName as string,
		DataHall as string,
		AssetNumber as integer,
		AssetName as string,
		RealtimePower_KW as decimal(18,3),
		RealtimePowerAverage_KW as decimal(18,3),
		RealtimePowerMax_KW as decimal(18,3),
		RealtimePowerMin_KW as decimal(18,3),
		RealtimeLastUpdated as timestamp,
		DeviceType as string,
		PDU_Zone as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(IsBlankRow = iif((isNull(SiteName) || trim(SiteName) == ''), 1, 0),
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUSer = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn split(IsBlankRow == 0,IsBlankRow == 1, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Process,Ignore,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Process sink(input(
		RealtimeLastUpdated as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DeviceType as string,
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RealtimePower_kW as double,
		RealtimePowerAverage_kW as double,
		DataHall as string,
		SiteName as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		RealtimePowerMin_kW as double,
		AssetNumber as integer,
		RealtimePowerMax_KW as double,
		AssetName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		RealtimeLastUpdated,
		DeviceType,
		UploadDate,
		RealtimePower_kW = RealtimePower_KW,
		RealtimePowerAverage_kW = RealtimePowerAverage_KW,
		DataHall,
		SiteName,
		ETLUser = ETLUSer,
		RealtimePowerMin_kW = RealtimePowerMin_KW,
		AssetNumber,
		RealtimePowerMax_KW,
		AssetName),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
